title: RefCon: Iterative Refinement and Contrastive Memory Extraction for Context-Evolving Agent
abstract: arXiv:2609.39143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agent interactions generate useful but noisy experience, and retraining models to absorb it is expensive. Context-evolving agents therefore need memory extraction methods that improve with more test-time compute without relying on gold labels. We propose RefCon, which combines sequential self-refinement with parallel self-contrast to extract higher-quality memories without gold labels. Evaluated on AppWorld and BFCL-V3 across multiple context-evolving agent frameworks, RefCon delivers strong and consistent gains, including relative improvements of 21.6% on ACE and 16.6% on ReMe over no-scaling baselines, while a diversity-focused variant (DivCon) achieves a 35.5% gain on ReasoningBank. RefCon consistently outperforms existing baselines without ground-truth labels, and generalizes across model scales and to software engineering tasks, where it surpasses even ground-truth baselines. translated_title: RefCon：面向上下文演化智能体的迭代精炼与对比式记忆提取
translated_abstract: 长时程智能体交互会产生有用但含噪声的经验，而通过重新训练模型来吸收这些经验代价高昂。因此，上下文演化智能体需要一种无需依赖黄金标签、且能随测试时计算量增加而不断提升的记忆提取方法。我们提出RefCon，它将序列式自我精炼与并行式自我对比相结合，在无黄金标签的情况下提取更高质量的记忆。在AppWorld和BFCL-V3上、跨多个上下文演化智能体框架进行评估，RefCon带来了强劲且一致的收益，包括相比无扩展基线在ACE上相对提升21.6%、在ReMe上相对提升16.6%，而一个侧重多样性的变体在ReasoningBank上取得了35.5%的提升。RefCon在无真值标签的情况下持续优于现有基线，并能跨不同模型规模泛化、迁移至软件工程任务，在这些任务上甚至超越了真值基线。
tldr: RefCon通过将序列式自我精炼与并行式自我对比相结合，在无需黄金标签的情况下提取更高质量的智能体记忆，在多个基准上相对无扩展基线显著提升（最高35.5%），并能泛化至软件工程任务且超越真值基线。
en_tdlr: RefCon combines sequential self-refinement with parallel self-contrast to extract higher-quality agent memories without gold labels, delivering consistent gains across benchmarks (up to 35.5%) and even surpassing ground-truth baselines on software engineering tasks.
